metrics.throughput: aggregate throughput in bit/s; legacy source cum suffix is instantaneous aggregate throughput

summary: median over seeds of per-seed tail average; cumulative loss is median over seeds of sum(reference-reward) over cycles0..2000

paired_bootstrap.paired_on: physical seeds1..25; same resampled indices for both methods
paired_bootstrap.statistic: difference of cross-seed medians of per-seed tail reward
paired_bootstrap.multiple_comparison_adjustment: none; all displayed intervals are individual95% percentile intervals
